title: The 59-Game Knicks Tenure That Changed EVERYTHING: Don Nelson's Legacy
description:
Today we honor Don Nelson, the legendary coach who passed away at age 86. Nelson's brief 59-game tenure with the Knicks in 1995-96 ended in failure—but it created the opportunity for Jeff Van Gundy to become a franchise icon. We explore how Nelson's innovative vision was decades ahead of its time, how his ideas now define modern basketball, and why his short Knicks stint inadvertently changed franchise history forever.

We also cover today's Knicks news: the Karl-Anthony Towns extension saga reaches a critical August 11 deadline, the search for a third center continues after Mitchell Robinson's departure to Boston, and the defending champions navigate a quiet but crucial offseason. Rest in peace to a true basketball visionary.
